acceptance_predicates.description: The installed ASB executable creates a runtime-owned cli2key authority for selected live run and sweep requests instead of emitting the missing-sidecar rejection.
Bootstrap accepts only the verified project-local cli2key receipt and pinned bridge identity; callers cannot supply endpoint, key, executable, or alternate bridge authority.
Normal dispatch receives only an opaque attempt factory while one loopback sidecar and private staging are retained and reaped for all terminal outcomes.
Public command-level fake coverage proves install, selection, workload run, bounded sweep, results, report, comparison, cancellation, and typed failures.
One bounded opt-in live development workload with the Codex agent reaches the real cli2key bridge path and records only redacted typed evidence.

definition_of_done: A user can install/select cli2key and execute a live Codex-agent workload and bounded sweep through the ordinary asb command; independent review, exact-head CI, signed merge, and post-merge verification pass.

inputs.description: AR-1732 and AR-1733 execution and qualification contracts.

outputs.description: Full standard-CLI cli2key live workload and sweep integration.

gates.description: The public installed CLI completes the fake cli2key install-to-run and sweep journey with hostile negative coverage.
A bounded opt-in live development workload reaches the real bridge path or reports an actionable typed development failure without secret retention.
